deviations.reason: macOS ships bash 3.2, which loses the inner quoting inside "$( ... )" and then BRACE-EXPANDS the config map {relationshipTypes:[...], sourceNodes:[...], ...} into four separate arguments. `scalar` received a different and invalid statement each time and returned empty. Found with `bash -x`, not by reading.
